Download **LivePlus-Ledger.apk** from the release assets to install on Android 8.0 or newer. **SHA256SUMS.txt** contains its checksum. GitHub's automatic source-code ZIP is not the Android installer.

Read the repository's **docs/INSTALLATION.md** before installing. Play Protect may block notification-listener sideloads; the documented owner workaround is not Google approval. Keep protection enabled for normal use.

Cashback values are estimates. Review merchant categories and reconcile with your card statement. Automatic notification capture depends on your phone and SMS/banking app. The initial phone screenshots show pasted transactions; live capture remains unconfirmed until device results are recorded.

The release APK uses the project's retained signing identity. Updates still need a higher Android versionCode and the same key. Export a backup before uninstalling or changing phones.
